title: Frontend Developer (Next.js)
description: We are looking for a passionate Frontend Developer to build stunning, high-performance web applications using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. You will work closely with our design team to create pixel-perfect digital experiences.
requirements: Strong proficiency in React.js and Next.js (App Router)
Deep understanding of Tailwind CSS and modern CSS animations
Experience with Framer Motion is a major plus
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and highly optimized code
A keen eye for premium UI/UX design details

title: UI/UX Designer
description: SaivaTech is seeking a creative UI/UX Designer to craft premium, dark-themed, conversion-focused websites and applications. You will be responsible for defining the user journey and creating visually captivating interfaces.
requirements: Proven experience in designing SaaS or Agency landing pages
Expertise in Figma and advanced prototyping
Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO)
Ability to create custom graphics and high-fidelity wireframes

title: Business Development Executive
description: Join our fast-growing agency to acquire new local businesses, coaching institutes, and startups as clients. You will manage leads, present solutions, and close high-ticket software and web development packages.
requirements: Previous B2B sales experience (preferably in IT/software)
Familiarity with digital marketing and web solutions
